title: Conditionally linear, matrix normal state space models
abstract: arXiv:2609.18734v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a class of linear state space models for matrix-valued time series data where the state is a latent matrix normal process. We derive matrix versions of the Kalman filter, log-likelihood, and smoother enabling estimation of the latent state matrix as well as the model's parameters. To conduct Bayesian inference, we provide algorithms that draw from the joint posterior distribution of the latent state matrices conditional on the observed data and parameters. We apply these methods to a large panel of U.S. macroeconomic time series across the 50 U.S. states. The proposed framework accommodates mixed-frequency data, heteroskedasticity, and outliers within a unified matrix-valued structure. Empirically, we find that a small number of latent factors captures the joint dynamics across states and variables, providing a parsimonious and scalable approach to modeling high-dimensional macroeconomic systems.

translated_title: 条件线性矩阵正态状态空间模型
translated_abstract: 我们为矩阵值时间序列数据开发了一类线性状态空间模型，其中状态是一个潜在的矩阵正态过程。我们推导了矩阵版本的卡尔曼滤波器、对数似然和平滑器，能够估计潜在状态矩阵以及模型的参数。为了进行贝叶斯推断，我们提供了从潜在状态矩阵在观测数据和参数条件下的联合后验分布中抽样的算法。我们将这些方法应用于涵盖美国50个州的大型宏观经济时间序列面板数据。所提出的框架在统一的矩阵值结构中兼容混合频率数据、异方差性和异常值。实证结果表明，少量潜在因子即可捕捉各州与各变量之间的联合动态，为高维宏观经济系统建模提供了一种简洁且可扩展的方法。
tldr: 该论文提出了一类用于矩阵值时间序列的矩阵正态状态空间模型，开发了矩阵版卡尔曼滤波、平滑及贝叶斯后验抽样算法，并在美国50个州的宏观经济数据上证明少量潜在因子即可简洁且可扩展地捕捉高维系统的联合动态。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a class of conditionally linear matrix normal state space models for matrix-valued time series, develops matrix versions of the Kalman filter, smoother, and Bayesian posterior sampling algorithms, and demonstrates on U.S. state-level macroeconomic data that a small number of latent factors parsimoniously and scalably captures the joint dynamics of high-dimensional systems.
